units.source_text: “你该不是把我的思想、见解跟我的过去混在一起，自己瞎琢磨吧。

en.t: Surely you are not mixing my thoughts and opinions together with my past and brooding over them on your own, are you?

units.source_text: 我虽然是个贫乏的思想家，但是，我从不对别人一味隐瞒自己头脑中成熟的思想，没有隐瞒的必要。

en.t: I may be a poor sort of thinker, but I never indiscriminately hide from others the thoughts that have matured in my mind; there is no need to hide them.

units.source_text: 至于你一定要我把自己的过去都告诉你，则是另外一个问题。”

en.t: But if you insist that I tell you everything about my past, that is a different matter.”

units.source_text: “我不认为是另外的问题。

en.t: “I do not think it is a different matter.

units.source_text: 正因为是先生的过去产生出来的思想，我才这么重视的。

en.t: It is precisely because these thoughts were born from your past that I value them so much.

units.source_text: 如果把两者割裂开来，对我而言便毫无价值，

en.t: If the two are torn apart from each other, they have no value to me,

units.source_text: 只给我一个没有注入灵魂的玩偶，我是不会满足的。”

en.t: and I will not be satisfied if you give me only a doll into which no soul has been breathed.”

units.source_text: 先生惊讶地望着我的脸，拿着烟的那只手微微颤抖着。

en.t: Sensei looked at my face in astonishment, and the hand holding his cigarette trembled slightly.

units.source_text: “你真是大胆。”

en.t: “You are truly bold.”

units.source_text: “只不过是认真罢了，我希望认真地接受人生的教训。”

en.t: “I am only serious. I want to receive the lessons of life seriously.”

units.source_text: “哪怕是揭开我的过去吗？”

en.t: “Even if that means laying bare my past?”

units.source_text: “揭开”这个词，突然以一种可怕的响声刺入我的耳中。

en.t: The word “laying bare” suddenly pierced my ears with a dreadful sound.

units.source_text: 我觉得坐在我面前的是一个罪人，而不是平时那位可敬的先生了。

en.t: I felt that the person sitting before me was a sinner, not the respectable Sensei I usually knew.

units.source_text: 先生的脸色变得很苍白。

en.t: Sensei's face had turned very pale.

units.source_text: “你是认真的吗？”先生叮问，

en.t: “Are you serious?” Sensei pressed me,

units.source_text: “我是因为过去的遭遇才怀疑别人的，其实也怀疑过你。

en.t: “Because of what happened to me in the past, I came to doubt other people; in fact, I have doubted you too.

units.source_text: 但是只有你，我实在不愿意怀疑。

en.t: But you alone are someone I truly do not want to doubt.

units.source_text: 你太单纯了，叫人难以怀疑。

en.t: You are so simple-hearted that it is hard to doubt you.

units.source_text: 我很想在死前，哪怕有一个人也行，我能够相信他，然后离开人世。

en.t: Before I die, I want to be able to trust even just one person and then leave this world.

units.source_text: 你能成为那唯一的人吗？

en.t: Can you become that one person?

units.source_text: 你愿意成为这样的人吗？

en.t: Are you willing to become such a person?

units.source_text: 你真是认真的吗？”

en.t: Are you truly serious?”
